newsitem.title: MEXICO: British business head on Mexico investment mission.
newsitem.headline: British business head on Mexico investment mission.

text.p: The director of the Confederation of British Industry (CBI) arrived in Mexico on Wednesday for a three-day visit aimed at stepping up bilateral trade and increasing British investment here, the British embassy said.
Adair Turner is the first high-level visitor to visit Mexico since the May 1 victory of Britain's Labour Party in a landslide national election.

"His visit shows clearly that the new government and British industry will continue working to strengthen Anglo-Mexican relations, especially so as to be Mexico's best European ally in reaching a fuller commercial agreement with the European Union," the embassy said in a statement.
During his visit, which ends on Friday, Turner will meet Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo and Mexico's energy, and transport and communications ministers.
He will also hold talks with the director of Mexican oil company Pemex.
The CBI is Britain's biggest employers' organisation, representing more than 250,000 companies in all sectors. ((-- Caroline Brothers, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7905))
